acceptance_predicates.description: A bound Git capability can execute one exact-head staged effect and return a verified receipt.
Process, identity, admission, and postcondition uncertainty is classified as rejection or ambiguity and is never reported as success.
The public upgrade dispatcher, rollback, release publication, and Dispatch remain rejection-only.

definition_of_done: Exact-head Git capability and durable-journal tests pass, including hostile identity and process-boundary cases.
Independent review and hosted Formal/Verify checks pass for the identical product revision.
No model-refinement proof or authorization prerequisite is added.

inputs.description: Existing immutable Git admission and commit capability.

outputs.description: Isolated Git effect entry point and executable evidence.
Independent review, hosted checks, and exact revision evidence.

gates.description: Hosted checks and review identify the same product revision.
Uncertain Git outcomes remain fenced and unretryable until recovery.
Public apply, rollback, release, and Dispatch remain disabled.
